Best Historic Sites & Landmarks in Switzerland

Where to experience Switzerland's iconic palaces, cathedrals, temples, castles, and ancient quarters.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

Switzerland is home to some of the world's richest architectural and cultural heritage, spanning ancient monuments, royal districts, and living old towns.
